Hello team,

I am writing as part of our quality audit for the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. I reviewed the travel workflow for companion animals to ensure safety remains the priority at every step, and that our guidance stays concise, kind, and actionable for travelers.

The boarding process has a strict operational deadline: boarding must be completed within 68 hours to meet our service standards. For escalations when coordination requires additional processing, we use the transfer extension EX-832 to route the case for prompt follow-up and oversight.

Please keep the tone and instructions consistent in all customer-facing communications. When working with travelers such as Aisha Nguyen and Layla Wong, confirm that Milolet’s itinerary steps align with the approved handling plan, and record any deviations immediately with the relevant desk notes.

Thank you for maintaining careful attention to procedure, documentation, and animal welfare.

Quality Auditor
Companion Animal Travel Desk
